To Our Roe,

Since 2014 you've been my partner, and since 2016 — when Annabelle arrived — you became the kind of mom I always knew you would be. Then Charlotte showed up in 2019 and somehow you leveled up again. These two girls hit the absolute jackpot.

You cook, you clean, you tackle homework, you fold laundry that I would have left in the basket until sometime next week. You remember every appointment, every school event, every permission slip that I didn't even know existed. Every time I ask "wait, what do we have going on this weekend?" I already know exactly what you're going to say — "It's in the calendar, Russell." And you know what? It is. It always is. Because you put it there. Along with everything else.

Without you, Annabelle and Charlotte would show up to the holidays with no gifts, and I'd be standing there nodding along pretending I knew exactly what they were getting all along.

I am genuinely, completely, embarrassingly lost without you. You are the GPS of this family, and I am a man who refuses to update his maps.

❈   ❈   ❈

But what makes you extraordinary isn't the logistics — it's you. The stories you tell them. The way you play with them. The love they feel just from being in the same room as you. That's the stuff Annabelle and Charlotte will carry with them forever.

And Roe — I also want you to know how incredibly proud I am of the work you've put into yourself these last six months. The commitment, the strength, the consistency — watching you show up for yourself every single day has been inspiring. You are a better version of someone who was already amazing, and that is no small thing. I am so proud to call you my wife.

So to celebrate everything you are and everything you've built, I got us tickets to see Sebastian Maniscalco at Jones Beach — because nothing says "you deserve a night out" like two hours of someone yelling about exactly the kind of family chaos you manage with grace every single day. 😂

I love you more than you know.

Happy Mother's Day,

Russell, Annabelle & Charlotte 🌸
